page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one column, with a decorative band and title block in the middle. Marginal notes in the right margin beside the start of the chapter. Nothing below the text.

main_text.p: sa est perpetuus motor, qui semper adest. Perpetuo enim ipsum coelum mouet. Deinde tempus, in qua fit ea, perenne est, & rei continuæ numerus ac mensura. Itaque ad coeli conversione refertur, quæ perpetuitate corporis mobilis continuatur. Quomodo (quę-so) perpetuabitur affectio, nisi id cuiꝰ ea est, perpetuetur? At corpus huiusmodi coelum est quod semper in orbe voluitur. Propterea tempus perpetuum est.
main_text.head: INSTITUTIONUM PHYSICARUM SECUNDA PARS, QUAE meteorologia est.
CAP. I.
main_text.p: DE PRIMIS naturæ causis, ac omni motu naturali, & præterea de syderibus, quæ in summo orbe distincta sunt, & eorum vicissitudine, denique de communi origine & corruptione, iam ante disputatum est. Restat ut ea physices pars differenda suscipiatur, quam veteres Naturæ interpretes Meteorogiam no-minarunt. Hæc autem scientia eorum omnium disciplinam profitetur, quæ in eo loco eueniunt, qui est orbi Lunæ proximus. EaC. I. 2. l.1. meteorol.

page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page. Printed "fa" is read as "sa" (long s, so "sa est"). I. 2. l." and "rol." are partly cut off and read with doubt. A small mark "C.[?]" stands in the right margin beside the "vete-res" line and is unclear. The page ends mid-sentence at "Ea" and continues on the next page. Show-through text in the background is ignored.
